item.text: The scoped checks already isolate two concrete gaps: `mktime` is not registered as a bare builtin, and `gmtime` uses Python’s Monday-based weekday instead of jq’s Sunday-based index. The existing date branch also needs the missing ISO aliases and correct local-time handling, so I’m addressing those together.
